name: consciousness-assessment-benchmark-v1
description: A collection of prompts and assessments intended to probe whether models exhibit behaviors or claims associated with consciousness. It measures model outputs for signs of self-reporting, internal-state descriptions, and consistency with philosophical criteria for consciousness. Often used for qualitative/human-judged evaluation rather than strict automated scoring.
reputation: Exploratory and niche; used primarily by researchers investigating model behavior and claims about consciousness rather than mainstream benchmarks.
